# Infant Rice Cereal

<section class="hmi-quick-read" id="infant-rice-cereal-quick-read" data-hmi-quick-read aria-labelledby="infant-rice-cereal-quick-read-label"><div class="hmi-quick-read-label" id="infant-rice-cereal-quick-read-label">Quick read</div>

Infant Rice Cereal in the HMI library has 21 reported results for lead, cadmium, total arsenic, inorganic arsenic, total mercury, nickel, chromium and uranium from 3 sources.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Cantoral A, Collado-López S, Betanzos-Robledo L, Lamadrid-Figueroa H, García-Martínez BA, Ríos C, Díaz-Ruiz A, Mariscal-Moreno RM, Téllez-Rojo MM · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico">Dietary Risk Assessment of Cadmium Exposure Through Commonly Consumed Foodstuffs in Mexico</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

<ul>
<li>
<strong>Metals measured:</strong>

Lead, cadmium, total arsenic, inorganic arsenic, total mercury and nickel and others, in 21 results from 3 sources.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Cantoral A, Collado-López S, Betanzos-Robledo L, Lamadrid-Figueroa H, García-Martínez BA, Ríos C, Díaz-Ruiz A, Mariscal-Moreno RM, Téllez-Rojo MM · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico">Dietary Risk Assessment of Cadmium Exposure Through Commonly Consumed Foodstuffs in Mexico</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</li>
<li>
<strong>Main drivers:</strong>

Form, basis and where the infant Rice Cereal was sampled; reporting limits decide how many results are non-detects.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Cantoral A, Collado-López S, Betanzos-Robledo L, Lamadrid-Figueroa H, García-Martínez BA, Ríos C, Díaz-Ruiz A, Mariscal-Moreno RM, Téllez-Rojo MM · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico">Dietary Risk Assessment of Cadmium Exposure Through Commonly Consumed Foodstuffs in Mexico</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</li>
<li>
<strong>Practical framing:</strong>

Ask for lot results with a quantification limit well below the limit that applies in the destination market.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Cantoral A, Collado-López S, Betanzos-Robledo L, Lamadrid-Figueroa H, García-Martínez BA, Ríos C, Díaz-Ruiz A, Mariscal-Moreno RM, Téllez-Rojo MM · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico">Dietary Risk Assessment of Cadmium Exposure Through Commonly Consumed Foodstuffs in Mexico</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</li>
</ul>

For a buyer the practical points are the form bought, the basis a result is reported on, where the infant Rice Cereal came from and the laboratory’s reporting limit. Testing finds contamination but does not remove it.

<a id="hmi-ing-002"></a>

This page covers infant Rice Cereal, as sold (21 results).<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Cantoral A, Collado-López S, Betanzos-Robledo L, Lamadrid-Figueroa H, García-Martínez BA, Ríos C, Díaz-Ruiz A, Mariscal-Moreno RM, Téllez-Rojo MM · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico">Dietary Risk Assessment of Cadmium Exposure Through Commonly Consumed Foodstuffs in Mexico</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/cantoral2024-cadmium-foodstuffs-mexico">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

Results stay on the basis each source reports: as sold or fresh weight, dry weight, or unstated. Dry-weight, as-sold and unstated results are never pooled, and no moisture conversion is applied.

<div class="hmi-analyte-explorer" id="hmi-occurrence-infant-rice-cereal" data-analyte-explorer data-compact-intro="true" data-source-summaries="true"><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure" data-explorer-context><summary data-open-context aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="hmi-occurrence-infant-rice-cereal-drawer">Comparison methods and scope</summary><div data-explorer-context-content>

<p>Each row is one statistic a source reports for one form of infant rice cereal, group and metal; percentiles, ranges and maxima reported for the same samples as a mean or median are shown on that row. Different forms and preparation states are kept apart, and dry-weight results never share a reference with as-sold or fresh-weight results. Ratings place a result against an HMI reference built from monitoring results and ordinary-setting medians for the same form and basis. Same-study contrasts compare a contaminated or treated site with its control, targeted with random sampling, a prepared form with the unprocessed one, or one group of a study with the median of its other groups. Held rows failed a check against their own source and are shown but not compared.</p>

Each sampling family has equal total weight. Non-detects stay as zero-to-limit intervals, so quartiles carry lower and upper bounds. Means, ranges and maxima never enter as observations. Other forms, other bases, targeted sampling and results from mining, industrial, wastewater-affected, experimental, fertiliser or manufacturer settings are kept out of this reference.</p><p>Inverse weighted empirical CDF; midpoint at exact cumulative-weight boundaries. This is a display eligibility rule, not statistical validation.</p><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Limitations</p><p>2 sampling families with different designs; none is a probability sample of world supply. <a id="hmi-ing-011"></a>
<a id="what-contamination-can-arise-from-agricultural-inputs-harvesting-processing-equipment-or-packaging"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-012"></a>
<a id="which-source-attribution-claims-are-measured-modelled-inferred-or-unresolved"></a>

No study in the library compared infant Rice Cereal from contaminated and ordinary settings, so the routes by which metals reach it are not measured here.
